conbody.p: A Virtual Private Network (VPN) is a secured private network connection built on top of a public network like the internet. This means your ISP (internet service provider) will not be able to sell your entire browsing history to the highest bidder.

If you are working with any sensitive data (student records, financial information) or email which passes sensitive data via conversations, you are required to either connect to Eduroam or the NC State VPN.
For more info about secure connections, visit the Secure Wifi Concept. .
